priceDisclaimer: Board and fastener prices are labeled defaultEnterable because 2026 retail lumber/composite prices move weekly and a citable Home Depot / published-average snapshot was not captured as a stable primary source. Users must overwrite defaults. Coverage, spacing, and waste factors are construction-practice defaults (IRC-style 16 in OC joists, 5/4×6 decking), not a price quote.

assumptions.beamSpacingNote: User-entered span; typical PT 2x10 double beam for residential decks — confirm with span tables / engineer.
assumptions.wastePctNote: 10% is a common rectangular-deck waste allowance. Picture-frame borders, diagonals, or many cutouts: use 15%.
assumptions.fastenerAllowanceNote: Hidden-clip count ≈ number of joist crossings. Face-screw count ≈ 2 screws per board per joist.

decking_5_4x6.note: actualWidth 5.5 in → 12/5.5 ≈ 2.182 lineal feet of decking per sq ft of deck (before waste).

decking_5_4x6_composite.note: Confirm the brand's actual width; some grooved boards net closer to 5.25–5.5 in.

joist_2x8_16oc.note: At 16 in OC, joist LF ≈ 0.75 × deck sf (plus rim/bands). User should add rim joist = perimeter.

joist_2x10_16oc.note: Same LF as 2x8; size changes for span, not coverage.

lumberTypes.name: Pressure-treated southern pine
lumberTypes.notes: Most common structural + decking choice. Requires periodic stain/sealer. Do not treat this default as a 2026 survey price.

lumberTypes.name: Western red cedar
lumberTypes.notes: Usually decking/rail only; framing still PT. Default is user-enterable.

lumberTypes.name: Capped composite — entry tier (generic, not a brand)
lumberTypes.notes: Generic stand-in for entry composite (e.g. grooved 12-ft or 16-ft boards). Hidden clips required. Not a Trex/TimberTech quote.

lumberTypes.name: Capped composite — premium tier (generic)
lumberTypes.notes: Generic stand-in for premium capped composite / PVC. User must paste a current store price.

lumberTypes.name: PT 2x8 joist
lumberTypes.notes: Framing default. Check span tables; many decks need 2x10.

fasteners.name: Coated deck screws (face-fastened)
fasteners.qtyRule: 2 screws × (decking LF / board_length_unused) — simpler: 2 screws per board per joist. Approx 0.25–0.35 lb or ~8–10 screws per sq ft for 5/4x6 @ 16 OC.
fasteners.notes: Stainless in coastal / cedar. Default price is not a 2026 SKU quote.

fasteners.name: Hidden deck clips (generic)
fasteners.qtyRule: About 1 clip per joist crossing per board edge. Approx 2.0–2.5 clips per sq ft at 16 in OC with 5.5 in boards.
fasteners.notes: Required for most grooved composite. Brand-specific clips; do not mix systems.

fasteners.name: Joist hangers + hanger nails (allowance)
fasteners.qtyRule: 1 hanger per joist end that does not sit on a beam. Ledger typically gets a hanger each joist.
fasteners.notes: Structural hardware — use listed hangers and nails. Default is an allowance, not a SKU.

fasteners.name: Ledger structural screws / lags (allowance)
fasteners.qtyRule: Per manufacturer spacing along ledger. User should treat this as an editable lump.
fasteners.notes: Flashing and proper attachment to structure are code-critical and not priced here.

otherAllowances.name: Concrete footing (sonotube + mix)
otherAllowances.notes: Not a published 2026 ready-mix quote. Depth/frost line is local.

otherAllowances.name: PT wood railing allowance
otherAllowances.notes: Installed-material allowance only. Typical whole-job averages already include basic rail; do not double-count if using those.

otherAllowances.name: Composite / metal railing allowance
otherAllowances.notes: User-enterable. Cable/glass systems are higher and not defaulted.

calculatorRecipe.installedBallpark: Prefer project-costs.json deck national $/sf × city wage multiplier rather than summing these defaults, until the user overwrites material prices.
